_meta.purpose: Machine-usable recovery semantics for Razorpay payment failure reasons.
_meta.provenance: Reason codes, descriptions and next_step guidance distilled from Razorpay's public error documentation (razorpay.com/docs -> Errors -> List of Errors, and the error-structure page defining code/description/field/source/step/reason).

source_semantics.customer: The customer made an error. Display a meaningful message and prompt them to retry.
source_semantics.business: Your integration sent an invalid request. Fix the request parameters before retrying.
source_semantics.gateway: The payment gateway or bank returned an error. Usually transient. Retry or switch method.
source_semantics.razorpay: Internal error at Razorpay's end. Retry after a short delay.

retryability.never: A retry on ANY instrument cannot succeed until an out-of-band change happens. Spending a retry here is pure waste.
retryability.new_instrument_only: The stored/attempted instrument is structurally unusable. Retrying the SAME instrument is guaranteed to fail; recovery requires the customer to supply a different one.
retryability.after_state_change: A retry can succeed, but only once an external state changes (balance tops up, a daily limit window resets, an outage clears). Timing is the whole game.
retryability.immediate: The customer was present and dropped out. Intent is still warm; a fast re-attempt has the highest yield of any class.

field_definitions.blame: Who must act for money to move. Drives whether we contact the CUSTOMER, page MERCHANT ops, or file an ENGINEERING ticket.
field_definitions.min_backoff_hours: Deterministic floor on how soon a retry may be attempted. Enforced by the policy engine, not by the LLM.
field_definitions.resolution_requires: The concrete precondition a retry needs. Used to explain to the merchant WHY we are or are not retrying.

instrument_dead.label: Instrument structurally unusable
instrument_dead.rationale: The card/account/VPA cannot authorise any amount. A retry ladder on this instrument is a guaranteed-zero action; the only path to money is the customer attaching a new instrument.

balance_dependent.label: Payer balance insufficient
balance_dependent.rationale: Balance is time-varying. Retry value is dominated by WHEN, not whether. Salary-cycle and prior-success-hour signals matter more than attempt count.

transient_infra.label: Transient issuer / gateway / PSP failure
transient_infra.rationale: Success probability is a function of the outage window, which Razorpay publishes via the Payment Downtime API. Retrying into an active high-severity downtime burns a bounded retry for near-zero expected value.

customer_dropout.label: Customer abandoned an in-flight authentication
customer_dropout.rationale: The payer was actively transacting seconds ago. This is the highest-intent, shortest-half-life recovery class in the whole taxonomy.

limit_bound.label: Instrument or network limit exhausted
limit_bound.rationale: The limit resets on a known cadence (usually 24h) or can be bypassed by switching rails. Retrying inside the same window cannot succeed.

risk_flagged.label: Declined by a risk or compliance check
risk_flagged.rationale: An automated system must never attempt to launder its way past a risk decline by retrying. This class is hard-stopped and escalated to a human.

merchant_config.label: Merchant account or method not configured
merchant_config.rationale: No amount of customer contact fixes this. Chasing the customer is an actively wrong action; the merchant must enable the method.

integration_bug.label: Malformed request from the merchant integration
integration_bug.rationale: This is a code defect surfacing as revenue loss. It belongs in a bug tracker, not a dunning queue.

already_settled.label: Money already collected
already_settled.rationale: The single most damaging false positive in revenue recovery: chasing a customer who has already paid. Hard-suppressed before any contact is generated.

mandate_broken.label: Recurring mandate not usable
mandate_broken.rationale: The debit authority itself is gone. Under the RBI e-mandate framework a fresh AFA-authenticated registration is required; retrying the debit is not a legal path to the money.

card_expired.next_step: The customer must retry with a valid card.

debit_instrument_blocked.description: The customer is using a blocked card. Blocked by the issuer or by the customer.
debit_instrument_blocked.next_step: The customer must retry with a different card or method.
debit_instrument_blocked.resolution_requires: issuer unblocks the card, or a different instrument is used

debit_instrument_inactive.next_step: Customer needs to activate the instrument or use another payment method.

card_number_invalid.next_step: Customer needs to enter a valid card number.

card_not_enrolled.description: The card is not enrolled for this payment method.
card_not_enrolled.next_step: Customer needs to enroll the card or use another card.
card_not_enrolled.resolution_requires: card enrolled with issuer, or a different card

bank_account_invalid.description: The bank account is not valid. The customer or bank could have closed the account.
bank_account_invalid.next_step: The customer must try using a valid bank account or another method.

invalid_vpa.description: The customer has entered an incorrect VPA.
invalid_vpa.next_step: The customer must check and enter the correct VPA.

transaction_on_vpa_restricted.description: Transaction on this VPA has been temporarily or permanently blocked by the PSP.
transaction_on_vpa_restricted.next_step: The customer must retry with another UPI ID.

user_not_registered_for_netbanking.description: The customer's bank account is not registered for netbanking.
user_not_registered_for_netbanking.next_step: The customer should register their account with the issuing bank.
user_not_registered_for_netbanking.resolution_requires: netbanking registration or a different method

vpa_resolution_failed.description: The UPI network failed to validate the VPA.
vpa_resolution_failed.next_step: The customer must retry using a different bank account or method.

insufficient_funds.description: The customer does not have sufficient funds in the account.
insufficient_funds.next_step: The customer must retry with a different card or method.

credit_limit_exceeded.description: The customer's credit limit has been exceeded.
credit_limit_exceeded.next_step: Customer needs to reduce the amount or use another payment method.
credit_limit_exceeded.resolution_requires: credit headroom restored, or a smaller amount

amount_less_than_minimum_amount.description: Amount in the payment request is less than the bank's minimum.
amount_less_than_minimum_amount.next_step: Ensure the payment amount exceeds the bank's minimum fee.

bank_technical_error.description: The issuing bank's Core Banking System hit a technical error while processing.
bank_technical_error.next_step: The customer must try using another bank account or another method.

issuer_technical_error.description: Technical error occurred at the card issuer.
issuer_technical_error.next_step: Please retry after some time or use another card.

gateway_technical_error.description: Technical error occurred at the gateway.

bank_not_available.description: Bank is not available due to a downtime or a technical issue.

bank_cutoff_in_progress.description: Bank CBS cutoff is in progress. This is a periodic event at the bank's end.

server_error.next_step: Please retry after some time or reach out to Razorpay.

payment_declined_due_to_high_traffic.description: Payment declined due to high traffic at the gateway.

invalid_response_from_gateway.description: Invalid response received from the gateway.

psp_app_not_available.description: PSP app is not available, possibly because of a downtime with the PSP.
psp_app_not_available.next_step: The customer must retry with another PSP app.
psp_app_not_available.resolution_requires: PSP recovers, or customer switches PSP

upi_app_technical_error.description: Technical error occurred at the customer's PSP.
upi_app_technical_error.next_step: The customer must retry. If it persists, try another UPI app.

authorisation_declined_by_psp.description: PSP app rejected the authorisation request; can indicate PSP downtime or a VPA issue.
authorisation_declined_by_psp.next_step: Recheck the VPA and retry. If recurring, the customer can choose another PSP app.

payment_failed.description: Payment processing failed at the bank or wallet gateway. No specific code received.
payment_failed.next_step: Please retry with a different payment method.

payment_declined.next_step: Customer needs to retry with another payment method.

card_declined.next_step: The customer must retry with a different card or method.
card_declined.resolution_requires: issuer approves, or a different card

verification_failed.description: Verification of the payment using the status check API has failed.
verification_failed.next_step: This is a temporary error. The customer must retry.

payment_cancelled.description: The customer explicitly cancelled the payment during authentication.
payment_cancelled.next_step: The customer must retry to complete the payment.

incorrect_otp.description: The customer entered an incorrect OTP.
incorrect_otp.next_step: The customer must retry and enter the correct OTP.

otp_expired.next_step: Customer needs to request a new OTP.

authentication_failed.description: 3D Secure or OTP authentication failed, possibly a cancel on the OTP screen.
authentication_failed.next_step: The customer must enter correct authentication details.

payment_timed_out.description: The customer did not complete the transaction within the specified time.
payment_timed_out.next_step: The customer must retry and complete within the time.

payment_session_expired.next_step: Customer needs to start a new payment session.

incorrect_cvv.description: The customer entered an incorrect CVV.
incorrect_cvv.next_step: The customer must retry and enter the correct CVV.

payment_collect_request_expired.description: The payment collect request has expired.
payment_collect_request_expired.next_step: Customer needs to retry the payment.
payment_collect_request_expired.resolution_requires: a fresh collect request the customer approves

otp_attempts_exceeded.next_step: Customer needs to wait and retry after some time.

transaction_daily_limit_exceeded.description: The customer exceeded the daily transaction limit set on the card.
transaction_daily_limit_exceeded.next_step: Retry using a different instrument or wait 24 hours.
transaction_daily_limit_exceeded.resolution_requires: daily limit window resets, or a different instrument

transaction_limit_exceeded.description: The customer exceeded the credit or debit limit set on their card.
transaction_limit_exceeded.next_step: Retry using a different bank's card or method.
transaction_limit_exceeded.resolution_requires: limit raised, or a different instrument

transaction_frequency_limit_exceeded.description: NPCI per-day frequency limit exhausted for this payer.
transaction_frequency_limit_exceeded.next_step: Please retry using another payment method.
transaction_frequency_limit_exceeded.resolution_requires: NPCI daily counter resets, or a non-UPI rail

transaction_daily_count_exceeded.description: The daily transaction count has been exceeded.
transaction_daily_count_exceeded.next_step: Customer needs to wait for the next day or use another payment method.

mcc_amount_limit_exceeded.description: The amount limit for this Merchant Category Code has been exceeded.
mcc_amount_limit_exceeded.next_step: Please reduce the amount or contact Razorpay.
mcc_amount_limit_exceeded.resolution_requires: smaller amount or MCC limit change

payment_risk_check_failed.description: Payment declined due to risk checks performed by Razorpay, the gateway or the issuer.
payment_risk_check_failed.next_step: The customer must retry with a different card or method.

compliance_violation.next_step: Please ensure the payment meets all compliance requirements.

payment_amount_tampered.description: The payment amount has been tampered.
payment_amount_tampered.next_step: The customer must retry with the correct amount.

international_transaction_not_allowed.next_step: Use a domestic payment method or enable international transactions.
international_transaction_not_allowed.resolution_requires: issuer enables international, or a domestic instrument

payment_method_not_enabled.description: The selected payment method is not enabled for your business.
payment_method_not_enabled.next_step: Reach out to Razorpay to enable the payment method.

bank_not_enabled.description: The selected bank is not enabled for your business.
bank_not_enabled.next_step: Please reach out to Razorpay to enable the selected bank.

card_network_not_enabled.description: The card's network is not enabled for the merchant.
card_network_not_enabled.next_step: Please reach out to Razorpay to enable the card network.

recurring_payment_not_enabled.next_step: Please enable recurring payments for your account.

upi_collect_not_enabled.description: UPI Collect flow is not enabled but a collect request was made.

merchant_not_activated.description: The merchant account is not activated.
merchant_not_activated.next_step: Please contact Razorpay to activate the merchant account.

invalid_order_id.description: Order ID in the payment request is missing or invalid.
invalid_order_id.next_step: Make sure the correct order ID is passed when initiating a payment.

order_amount_mismatch.description: The order amount differs from the payment amount.
order_amount_mismatch.next_step: Pass the same amount in both payment and order requests.

order_payment_method_mismatch.description: The method in the order request differs from the payment request.
order_payment_method_mismatch.next_step: Do not pass method in the create order request.

input_validation_failed.description: Payment failed due to a wrong request or input.
input_validation_failed.next_step: Rectify the validation issues and try again.

duplicate_request.description: A duplicate request has been submitted.

order_already_paid.description: There can only be one successful payment per order ID; a payment is already completed for this order.
order_already_paid.next_step: Check order status before initiating a new payment attempt.
order_already_paid.resolution_requires: nothing - the money is already collected

mandate_creation_failed.next_step: Customer needs to retry mandate creation or use another payment method.

mandate_creation_declined.next_step: Customer needs to retry mandate creation or use another payment method.

mandate_creation_expired.next_step: Customer needs to retry mandate creation.

reqauth_mandate_not_acknowledged.description: Request authentication mandate is not acknowledged.
reqauth_mandate_not_acknowledged.next_step: Customer needs to acknowledge the mandate.

funds_blocked_by_mandate.description: Funds are blocked by an existing mandate.
funds_blocked_by_mandate.next_step: Customer needs to release the mandate or use another account.

upi_autopay_not_supported_on_psp.description: UPI Autopay is not supported on this PSP.
upi_autopay_not_supported_on_psp.next_step: Please retry with another PSP app.
upi_autopay_not_supported_on_psp.resolution_requires: mandate re-registered on a supporting PSP
